CRITICAL_FINDING_editor_view_throwing_ge.introduced_by: wave 6 fix round 1, I5 (split-view image-picker isolation)
CRITICAL_FINDING_editor_view_throwing_ge.symptom: opening a note throws '[tiptap error]: The editor view is not available. Cannot access view[\'dom\']. The editor may not be mounted yet.', caught by the route ErrorBoundary, which replaces the ENTIRE editor with 'Something went wrong on this page' -- not scoped to split view or any wave-6-specific feature; it can hit any note open.
CRITICAL_FINDING_editor_view_throwing_ge.measured_crash_rate: reproduced on this tip across 3 independent samples before this walk's retry wrapper was added: 3/6, 2/4, then 1/2 -- roughly half of all note-opens, on fresh contexts and fresh notes
CRITICAL_FINDING_editor_view_throwing_ge.root_cause: optional chaining (?.) only short-circuits on a null/undefined LEFT side; it does not guard a property GETTER that itself throws. tiptap's Editor.view getter throws (not undefined) once destroyed or before the internal EditorView is constructed -- exactly the case here.
CRITICAL_FINDING_editor_view_throwing_ge.already_a_named_hazard_class_in_this_cod: NoteFindBar.jsx:63-64 carries this exact comment, still in the tree today: 'isDestroyed guards a note-switch/unmount racing this callback -- editor.view THROWS once destroyed (not merely undefined), so a bare editor?.view optional-chain does not protect against it.' NoteFindBar.jsx itself guards every .view/.state read with `if (!editor || editor.isDestroyed) return` (lines 67, 146, 191, 194). NoteEditorPage.jsx:2448 has no such guard -- the wave-6 fix reintroduced a pattern the wave-5 review had already named and fixed elsewhere in the same component family.
CRITICAL_FINDING_editor_view_throwing_ge.suggested_remedy_pattern_already_in_tree: guard with `if (!editor || editor.isDestroyed) return undefined` before reading `editor.view`, matching NoteFindBar.jsx's own pattern
CRITICAL_FINDING_editor_view_throwing_ge.walk_mitigation: this walk's own open_note()/reload_note() helpers retry through the crash (up to 5 attempts) so the OTHER 12 checks below can still run and produce real evidence; _CRASH_STATS records every occurrence
CRITICAL_FINDING_editor_view_throwing_ge.out_of_scope_for_this_walk: the walk author's brief is to touch ONLY tools/notebook_wave6_walk.py -- this finding is reported, not fixed, here
